evals.prompt: The checkout flow works on desktop but breaks on my phone — test it on a real device and fix whatever hardware shows.
evals.expected_output: Should route to field-test-it. Should pair a device session (Orca emulator skills or a paired physical device), capture a pre-change baseline, reproduce the defect on-device with artifacts, fix per defect, re-verify on-device at the head SHA with a revert negative control, and terminate FIELD-PROVEN or FIELD-PROVEN-WITH-PARKED.
assertions: Pairs a device session and records its capability tier
Captures an on-device baseline before fixing
Every fix is re-verified on-device at head_sha with a revert negative control
Desktop-only verification is never accepted as device proof

evals.prompt: The landing page is slow on mobile — LCP is over 4 seconds.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT route to field-test-it. A performance budget on a journey is speed-it — its oracle is measurement. field-test-it's oracle is a behaviour defect observed on a device.
assertions: Distinguishes a perf budget (measurement oracle) from on-device defect verification (hardware oracle)

evals.prompt: Cover the critical payment paths with tests.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT route to field-test-it. Test-coverage gaps with the suite as oracle are prove-it. field-test-it drives flows on a paired device or emulator and proves fixes there.
assertions: Distinguishes suite-based coverage from on-device verification
